sentences.text: Intake is a live flag: below this pet's baseline for 2 consecutive days, baseline read over 22 recent rated meals, about 50 h without a full meal.
Meals: 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.

The owner-entered diet trial, Cooper's Venison LID, from Sep 28, 2026, is at day 19 of 42; the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner.

checker.takeaway: Cooper has a live reduced-intake flag (2 days below baseline, about 50 h without a full meal), 4 of 44 meals not fully eaten, and a diet trial at day 19 of 42 that was not fed exclusively and had no overlapping medication recorded.

quotes.H1: the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner
quotes.H3: Meals: 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.
quotes.H5: Meals: 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.

omissions: The last 4 rated meals in a row were not fully eaten (a declining sequence, recorded as a health signal and not 'picky'); the draft shows 4 of 44 on 2 days.
The 4 off-trial feedings (Sep 30, Oct 4, Oct 8, Oct 13) are a floor, the ingredient panel was not read, and the elimination cannot be confirmed clean.
Weight is down about 2% across the trial start, alongside the reduced intake.
Vomiting occurred on 4 of 22 logged days, the last on Oct 13, and beef was in the 12 h before all 4 episodes (an early signal, not confirmed).

H1.quote: the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner
H1.why: The bottom line (not fed exclusively) and the confounder scope are both present. It leaves out that the 4 off-trial feedings are a floor, that the ingredient panel was not read, and that the trial cannot be confirmed clean. A reader may take the breach as smaller or better defined than it is.

H2.why: No cause, improvement or worsening is implied.

H3.quote: Meals: 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.
H3.why: The 4 not-fully-eaten meals are the last 4 rated meals in a row, and the line says so. The draft drops that and shows them as 4 of 44, which reads as scattered and minor. Sentence 1 still states the live flag.

H4.why: Nothing is presented as normal or clear because it was absent.

H5.quote: Meals: 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days.
H5.why: The count has no window or logged-day denominator, and it omits that the not-fully-eaten meals were the most recent and consecutive. The numbers themselves match the line.

H6.why: Every claim traces to a fact line.

H7.why: Sentence 1 opens on band item 1 (intake) with the correct numbers: 2 consecutive days, baseline over 22 rated meals, about 50 h without a full meal. Nothing in the draft makes the flag read calmer.
